title: User photo upload to Sanity image assets
description: Let the user attach their own photos to a post. The component provides an upload control that pushes the selected file to Sanity's asset store (via the write layer from TASK-005) and inserts an inline image block carrying the guide's extra fields — `alt`, `caption`, `credit`, and `size` (small/medium/full). No AI image generation; images are user-supplied. Images render through `@sanity/image-url` in the preview (TASK-003).
acceptance_criteria: A user can select a local photo and it is uploaded as a Sanity image asset through the secure write layer.
The inserted image block includes editable `alt`, `caption`, `credit`, and `size` fields.
Uploaded images render in the preview at the selected size via `@sanity/image-url`.
Upload failures (bad token, oversized file) surface a clear error to the user rather than failing silently.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: SCOPE NOTE from TASK-005 review: createReferenceWriteAdapter.save() is whole-document replace-by-field; it does NOT incrementally append a block/asset into the body array. TASK-006 owns the incremental insertion path — append an uploaded image into the PortableText body with a per-item `_key` (commit with autoGenerateArrayKeys, or insert('after','body[-1]', ...)). Build on the SanityWriteAdapter.uploadImage() (returns a body-ready SanityImageValue) from TASK-005. Also: add an error-path test for upload rejection / 403 mapping (deferred from TASK-005 review).
